Reading in data as homicides R object 

```{r}

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

homicides <- read_csv("~/R_Programming_for_Research_ERHS_535/Homework 5 - Reproducible research #2/data/homicide-data.csv")

homicides <- homicides %>%
  mutate(city_name = paste(city, state, sep = ", "))

```
